Your boss texts, Big day, mate. Only 80 years till retirement.
Welcome to a world where humans live to 200.
At 25, your granddaughter applies for a job. The listing says entry level. They want 40 years of experience.
At 100, you finally save enough to buy the house you grew up in. The owner opens the door.
It's your great-grandad. He says, Sorry, mate. I'm saving it for when I retire.
Then you get home and find your 130-year-old dad teaching your granddaughter how to make pancakes.
Same burnt edges. Same stupid joke he told you when you were six.
Suddenly, you want every one of those extra years.
